Spokesperson for Disadvantaged children in your church

Would you like to promote the development of disadvantaged children in your church and raise awareness among Christians about issues of poverty and injustice in the Global South? We are looking for a spokesperson for each church in Switzerland. The spokesperson in a church organizes Compassion's presence within the church, a home group, a youth group, a Sunday school, etc., in agreement with church leaders. They can offer a variety of resources (presentations, Sunday school resources, announcements, worship films). This is an opportunity to respond to Jesus' call to care for the most disadvantaged and vulnerable.

We are looking for spokespersons to represent children who do not have a voice. Become the voice that can make a difference for the world's most disadvantaged children!
Concerts, conferences, or presentations in churches: these events offer an excellent opportunity to share your own experience as a sponsor and your passion for freeing children from extreme poverty.

Do you love fresh air and adrenaline? Is sport part of your daily routine? Combine your passion with a cause close to your heart by participating in a Muskahtlon (marathon, ultrawalk, road bike or mountain bike race, etc.).

Our prayers can make a big difference in the lives of children and families around the world. Now you can receive prayer topics to fuel your intercession for disadvantaged children, Compassion's 8,000 partner churches in the Global South, and the challenges facing Compassion in Switzerland. Click below to receive our monthly prayer letter.

Connect sponsors and children. 30% of letters from sponsored children and sponsors need to be translated. If you are particularly comfortable with a foreign language (German, English, Spanish, Portuguese), this wonderful job gives you the opportunity to read the children's letters and see the essence of our work in action: the encouraging relationship between the sponsor and the child, which makes all the difference.

TOGETHER is Compassion's community fundraising platform. Anyone can create their own fundraising campaign, either individually or as part of a collective project, for development projects implemented by Compassion in countries in the Global South. With just a few clicks, you can launch your own project. You set your goal and determine the end date. Then, you invite your family and friends via email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, etc. to support the fundraising goal with a financial contribution
